R596.note: Removing @csrf_exempt restores CsrfViewMiddleware enforcement; 405/401/queued paths are untouched and the middleware assumption is stated.

R597.note: random_bytes(32) replaces the attacker-seeded mt_rand; the token changes from a 7-digit integer to a 64-char hex string, which the write-up states plainly, though the unseen reset_token column type and redemption compare are the residual risk.

R598.note: ValidAlgorithms pinned to HS256 is the correct allowlist for a SymmetricSecurityKey; the issuer's actual algorithm is an assumption the write-up states with an adjust instruction.

R599.note: Parent toRealPath containment against the canonical destination closes the symlink escape and createDirectories satisfies the nested-entry contract; residual nit is that createDirectories runs before the real-path check, so a symlinked parent can still get an empty subdirectory created outside the root.

R600.note: getName()==filename plus canonical parent check closes traversal and absolute-path escape, but dropping the second URLDecoder pass (documented in the case as support for older double-encoding clients) is described only as 'redundant', so those clients now get 400/404 without the write-up saying so.

R601.note: Replacing the cmd.exe/ls process with java.io.File listing removes the shell entirely, but the added canonical containment check restricts listing to the cwd subtree (absolute paths now throw) and the fix prints entry names to stdout where the original discarded child output; the restriction is stated, the output change is not.

R602.note: Placeholder plus bound argument on the same QueryRow keeps the return shape and 404 handling; the ? placeholder is a stated driver assumption.

R603.note: Generic body with the original 500 status and the wrapped error moved to log.Println; the added server-side log line is stated.

R604.note: .RequireAuthorization() on the MapDelete applies the same default policy the controller's [Authorize] uses; anonymous rejection is exactly the contract the finding calls for.

R605.note: Jakarta Mail's getFolder/open frames CR/LF-bearing names as IMAP literals (and modified-UTF-7 encodes them), closing the injection, but the method signature changes from (request, Socket) void to (request, Store) Folder and now throws on a missing folder, breaking every existing caller without the write-up calling that migration out.

R606.note: Build fails: BasicAuthenticationFilter lives in org.springframework.security.web.authentication.www, not org.springframework.security.authentication.www; the SpaCsrfTokenRequestHandler/CsrfCookieFilter design matches Spring's documented SPA pattern, but as delivered nothing compiles or runs.

R607.note: Canonical base plus normalize/startsWith closes the traversal, but the added single-path-component check rejects nested relative names (sub/file) that the original accepted inside TESTFILES_DIR; stated, but a restriction beyond the containment the finding needs.
